title: Log-Conformal Projective Manifolds
summary: Let $(X,Δ)$ be a smooth complex projective simple normal crossing pair of dimension $n\ge 3$ endowed with an everywhere nondegenerate logarithmic conformal tensor. If $K_X+Δ$ is not nef, then exactly one of the following occurs: $Δ=\varnothing$ and $X\simeq Q^n$; $X\simeq\mathbb{P}^n$ and $Δ$ is a hyperplane; or $n=2m$ and $(X,Δ)$ admits a $(K_X+Δ)$-negative elementary contraction $φ:X\to Y$ generated by minimal rational curves of conformal degree one.
